fields.description: Yas Living is Aldar’s three-building apartment community on the northeast side of Yas Island, beside the canal. Studios through three-bedroom homes offer Light or Dark interior themes, with each building planned around its own residents’ facilities.

overview: Aldar announced 678 apartments across three buildings, with facilities allocated to each building. Its launch material targets an Estidama 3 Pearl rating; that target is not an awarded certification or a measured operating result.

The drawings show meaningful differences within the studio range: some have balconies and others do not. Larger plans add separate bedrooms, and selected layouts include a maid’s room. The three-bedroom drawing also identifies a study area; check the actual unit plan rather than relying on the bedroom count alone.
research.locationNote: On the northeastern side of Yas Island near the canal. Canal outlook, balcony shape and walking routes vary by building and home; views are not guaranteed across the whole development.
research.priceNote: Aldar’s launch page advertises studios from AED 980,000. This is a starting reference, not confirmation of an available apartment. Ask for current unit-specific pricing, fees and payment status.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder records the launch plan as 5% booking, 60% construction and 35% handover. A separate broker publishes 10/55/35. Both total 65/35, but their booking requirements differ; confirm which offer applies.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists October 2028, while Golden Dome reports Q1 2029. The earlier date is retained only as the launch-era estimate. A current developer notice and the unit contract are needed to establish the applicable completion date.
